item.title: Spring Memorandum 2026

item.title: Exemption residence requirement
item.description: A proposal to waive the requirement for aldermen to live in Utrecht has been made. This could make it possible for more people to become aldermen. It is not yet clear who will be affected by this.

item.title: Spring memo 2026
item.description: There is a spring memo for 2026. This outlines how the municipality wants to spend its money. It is not yet clear who will be affected by this.

item.title: Appointment of aldermen
